description: Defines the WebSocketRouteDispatcher class for managing WebSocket routes within the Playwright testing framework, including event handling, API requests, and integration with page and browser context dispatchers.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteDispatcher
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route lifecycle, event dispatching, and communication between page or browser context and WebSocket mock.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up WebSocket routing and exposes binding for WebSocket events.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes WebSocket routing and cleans up bindings and scripts.

methods.name: sendToPage
methods.description: Sends a message to the page via WebSocket.

methods.name: sendToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the server via WebSocket.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection from the page side.

methods.name: closeServer
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection from the server side.

methods.name: _evaluateAPIRequest
methods.description: Helper to evaluate WebSocket API requests within the frame context.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup upon disposal of the dispatcher.

methods.name: _executionContextGone
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the execution context is no longer available.
